Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::cancelReservation(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		reservedCopy: BookCopy = Reserved.allInstance()->any(o|o.ReservedUser.UserID = uid and
		o.ReservedCopy.Barcode = barcode),
		reservation: Reserve = reservedCopy.ReservationRecord->any(o|o.ReservedUser.UserID = uid and
		o.ReservedCopy.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		reservation.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newReservation: Reserve in
		newReservation.oclIsNew() and
		Reserved.allInstance()->includes(newReservation) and
		newReservation.ReservedCopy = reservedCopy and
		newReservation.ReservedUser = self and
		result = true
}
